title: Fraction
statementMd:
Petya is a big fan of mathematics, especially its part related to fractions. Recently he learned that a fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b952567ba3e261d77a18b5b9445bc9882737e6b6.png) is called *proper* iff its numerator is smaller than its denominator ($*a* < *b*$) and that the fraction is called *irreducible* if its numerator and its denominator are coprime (they do not have positive common divisors except $1$).

During his free time, Petya thinks about proper irreducible fractions and converts them to decimals using the calculator. One day he mistakenly pressed addition button ($+$) instead of division button ($÷$) and got sum of numerator and denominator that was equal to $*n*$ instead of the expected decimal notation.

Petya wanted to restore the original fraction, but soon he realized that it might not be done uniquely. That's why he decided to determine maximum possible proper irreducible fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b952567ba3e261d77a18b5b9445bc9882737e6b6.png) such that sum of its numerator and denominator equals $*n*$. Help Petya deal with this problem.

## Input

In the only line of input there is an integer $*n*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$), the sum of numerator and denominator of the fraction.

## Output

Output two space-separated positive integers $*a*$ and $*b*$, numerator and denominator of the maximum possible proper irreducible fraction satisfying the given sum.
statementZhMd:
Petya 是一位数学爱好者，尤其喜欢与分数相关的内容。最近，他了解到分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b952567ba3e261d77a18b5b9445bc9882737e6b6.png) 当且仅当其分子小于分母（$*a* < *b*$）时被称为*真分数*；当分子与分母互质（除了 $1$ 以外没有其他正公约数）时，该分数被称为*既约分数*。

在空闲时间，Petya 会思考真既约分数，并使用计算器将它们转换为小数。有一天，他误将加法按钮（$+$）按成了除法按钮（$÷$），于是得到的不是预期的小数表示，而是分子与分母之和，结果等于 $*n*$。

Petya 想要还原原来的分数，但很快他意识到这可能无法唯一确定。因此，他决定找出满足分子与分母之和等于 $*n*$ 的最大可能真既约分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b952567ba3e261d77a18b5b9445bc9882737e6b6.png)。请帮助 Petya 解决这个问题。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含一个整数 $*n*$，表示分数的分子与分母之和。

## 输出格式

输出两个用空格分隔的正整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$，分别表示满足给定和的最大可能真既约分数的分子和分母。
